method: Raw cosine over all synthetic documents; scope, expiry, fact and session eligibility use the real Store. Threshold semantic metrics rank by cosine alone; gate metrics add lexical overlap and are not full service ranking metrics.
limitations: Small synthetic calibration/holdout, not a benchmark. The holdout was authored before this run and must not be edited after observing its scores. A global threshold cannot remove irrelevant lexical matches or distinguish all semantically related but incorrect facts.

holdout_dataset.description: Independent synthetic holdout frozen before first calibration run.

recommendation.rationale: Conservative provisional default. 0.45, 0.50 and 0.55 retain 11/12 independent positives; 0.50 also rejects a 0.471 original-fixture non-target match. 0.60 drops another valid translation. Not a general optimum.
known_tradeoffs: Original oolong-beverage positive cosine 0.404985 is below Oslo-to-Berlin negative 0.412114; a global threshold cannot retain the positive and reject the negative together.
Independent commute-question positive cosine 0.368566 is missed by conservative thresholds; the label is retained.
Two independent unrelated queries still have lexical function-word overlap; cosine thresholds cannot remove those matches.
